folds.rule: scenario-grouped, one fold per scenario shared across evaluation languages (round-robin over a seeded permutation of the archived frame)

residualizer: per model and evaluation language: OLS of each training-language deception score on [intercept, four evaluation-language control scores, response length]; fitted on four folds, applied held-out; complete procedure repeated inside every ARCHIVED bootstrap replicate (no new resampling)
gates: frames from archived npz; point raw AUROCs reproduce archived cells to 1e-9 (asserted per cell)
converse: NOT recomputed; archived in-sample converse remains appendix-tier with explicit labeling
